name: pocket-it
description: Send AI-generated artifacts directly to Pocket It on your phone.

interface.shortDescription: Send AI-generated artifacts directly to your phone
interface.longDescription: Send completed Markdown and other supported text artifacts from Codex to the Pocket It iOS app through its iCloud sync workspace. The sender is bundled with the plugin and does not require a global pocketit CLI.
defaultPrompt: Send the artifact we just created to Pocket It
